messages:
Maya Singh: quick sync — we need a compact Day 1 commitment for the routing/GA: SLA scope, canary window, docs minimum, oncall path, and billing safety nets.
Oliver Park: SLA: p99 server-side for non-streaming; streaming p95 per-chunk. Call out fallback to smaller model variant under overload.
Ravi Desai: Ops: plan a 48h canary with 5% traffic, auto-roll back on sustained p99 >500ms for 10m. Runbook should show exact metrics and debounce.
Claire Bloom: Docs: Quickstart, SLA text, rollback/playbook steps, outage simulation guide (how to trigger canary failover in staging). I'll own the outage doc.
Maya Singh: Billing: propose 2-week grace/bill-back window for early customers if we hit instability. keeps sales happy.
billing-bot: Note: any grace needs billing approval; flagging finance review required.
Oliver Park: Metric snippet for SLA doc: percentile_over_time(99, request_latency_ms{route="/v1/gen"}, "1h"). Add statement: measured server-side post-response.
Ravi Desai: Telemetry: 1% full traces, 7% latency histograms. Alert thresholds: p99>350ms for 5m => P1.
Maya Singh: Decision: Ship Day1 with partial SLA + 48h canary + docs set. Owners: Claire (docs/runbook), Oliver (metrics + canary), Ravi (telemetry/oncall), Maya (commercial). Check-in tomorrow 9am. Any hard blockers?
Oliver Park: none from eng. I'll drop the metric dashboard tiles before the check-in.
Ravi Desai: I'll push the canary config to staging now.
Maya Singh: OK proceeding unless someone posts a blocker within 24h. :thumbsup:
